ns2:course.label: Muslims in America
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the study of Muslims in the United States and broadly the history of Islam in the Americas. Using a comparative approach, we study how the historical narrative of African American and Latino Muslims relates to newer immigrant populations, primarily Arab American and South Asian American Muslim communities. Same as LLS 258 and REL 258.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci, and Cultural Studies - US Minority course.
